first_3s_text: He's hiding a whole castle behind hay so it can never be torn
transcript: He's hiding a whole castle behind hay so it can never be torn down His bet Stay unseen for four years One look from the council and they can order it gone Battlements cannons his family living inside The council never sees a thing Four years later the bails come down He thinks he's won Then the court rules Hiding it was part of building it So it wasn't finished until the hay came down The clock hadn't even started His last stand Bats and newts Apparently they've moved in Knock it down he says and you'd break wildlife law Rejected The judge Tear it down or face jail So he tears down his own castle Beaten by the hay he hid it with
